claim: Visitors can open a seeded sample workspace in one click, immediately see sample work, and leave real profile data unchanged.
sandbox: fresh 390 x 844 browser context; click the landing action; assert the demo route, in-viewport sample heading and review note, banner, and only the demo-prefixed storage key

claim: The sample changes text, code, contrast, and table settings and can be reset.
sandbox: fresh demo context; change and persist a setting; reload; reset; leave demo; assert only the demo data is discarded and an unrelated local record remains

claim: The website demo has no analytics, cookies, accounts, or third-party runtime requests and uses only demo-prefixed local storage.
sandbox: intercept every request during the complete demo flow; assert same-origin only, no cookies, and only the demo storage namespace

claim: The product site and interactive demo reload offline after the first visit.
where: landing first screen, offline notice, /privacy, README
sandbox: fresh context; activate the service worker; reload under browser offline mode; assert CSS and demo behavior

claim: The Chromium extension is free to download and requires no account or payment.
sandbox: fresh landing page; assert the no-account fact and unzip the same-origin downloadable package

claim: The packaged extension loads and runs in Chromium.
sandbox: fresh Chromium profile; load only dist/extension and verify its popup and content script

claim: The packaged extension provides commands to pause or resume and cycle profiles.
sandbox: download and unpack the release archive; assert all three command IDs and advertised default bindings in its manifest

claim: A saved profile returns on the same work site, remains independent by work site, and can be paused without changing browser zoom.
sandbox: fresh Chromium profile; assign a custom profile, reload and open a same-host page, compare a second host, check zoom, then pause and resume

claim: Reading and code text sizes change while headings, navigation, and controls retain their size.
where: landing profile and control sections, README
sandbox: packaged extension on the sample work page; set maximum reading/code values and compare computed text plus heading/control geometry

claim: Optional table spacing changes cell padding without changing table headings, values, or structure.
sandbox: packaged extension on the sample table; compare cell padding and assert all table text and markup remain unchanged

claim: The packaged extension supports reading text from 14 to 28 px, line spacing from 1.2 to 2, and code text from 13 to 26 px.
sandbox: packaged extension; assert control endpoints and apply minimum and maximum values to the injected stylesheet

claim: The focus and pointer option adds a larger cursor and a high-contrast keyboard focus outline.
sandbox: packaged extension; enable the option, assert injected cursor and focus rules, and calculate at least 4.5:1 outline contrast

claim: A fresh extension contains Calm reading, Balanced work, and Code focus profiles.
sandbox: fresh packaged extension; assert the initial profile selector has exactly the three named options

claim: A new custom profile copies every setting from the current profile.
sandbox: set distinctive values, create a named profile with Enter, and inspect the saved profile values

claim: The extension provides standard, stronger, and maximum text contrast settings.
sandbox: select each packaged contrast setting and assert its distinct computed filter on sample text

claim: The extension stores one local settings record, requests no history or cookies permission, and sends no third-party requests during use.
sandbox: fresh Chromium profile; run the full extension flow; inspect storage, permissions, and all HTTP requests

claim: The extension changes presentation without editing page text or element structure.
sandbox: capture sample main text, element count, and table markup before profile changes; assert an exact match afterward

claim: A custom profile can be deleted from the popup and assigned sites return to Calm reading.
sandbox: create and assign a named profile; confirm deletion; assert the option disappears and Calm reading is selected

claim: Browser-internal pages stay unchanged and the popup explains what to do next.
sandbox: open a Chromium internal page, reload the packaged popup, and assert the designed unsupported-page recovery state
